lemmas.name: sort_array_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int), List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ((l.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).toArray.toList) ∧ List.isPerm l ((l.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).toArray.toList) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  have hp : (l.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).Perm l := List.mergeSort_perm l _
  have hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b) = true) (l.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))) :=
    List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) l
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hs
  · simpa using List.isPerm_iff.mpr hp.symm
